## Bringing the Wild West to Vice City: Finding Arthur Morgan's Outfit in GTA 6

For fans of Rockstar Games' legendary catalog, Arthur Morgan from Red Dead Redemption 2 remains one of the most iconic protagonists in gaming history. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet GameRant, players who want to traverse the world of GTA 6 while channeling the beloved cowboy's style can actually do so by outfitting Jason in Arthur Morgan's signature look.

While the Grand Theft Auto series and the Red Dead Redemption franchise are set in completely different eras, Rockstar Games has a long-standing tradition of including subtle nods, easter eggs, and cross-franchise references in their open-world masterpieces. If you want to give Jason that classic rugged cowboy aesthetic, you will need to head to specific locations across the map to complete the full outfit.

### How to Complete the Look

For players who enjoy character customization and hunting down hidden secrets, tracking down these specific apparel items adds an extra layer of engagement to the open-world experience. To successfully pull off the Arthur Morgan look for Jason, players must:

* Travel to the designated locations highlighted by exploration guides.
* Collect and equip the necessary clothing components to match the iconic style.
* Explore the modern setting of the game with a distinct Wild West twist.

This kind of crossover aesthetic not only appeals to longtime fans of the developer's previous titles but also enhances the overall roleplaying experience for Jason. Industry analysis suggests that discovering such nostalgic easter eggs will likely become a favorite pastime for players sharing their custom character screenshots online.

## Editor's Take

Blending the legendary aesthetic of Red Dead Redemption 2 into the modern setting of GTA 6 is a fantastic treat for fans. It bridges the gap between Rockstar's two biggest franchises and adds a wonderful layer of fan service that rewards dedicated players exploring the map.
